input.summary: Extend the licence to contractors acting on Sparkling's behalf and permit transfer of the licence to a successor in an M&A transaction.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the grant to contractors acting on our behalf and added a successor-transfer right, since our playbook requires the licence to survive a merger or sale and to cover the third parties who operate the system for us. We are happy to keep the transfer limited to a genuine M&A successor that assumes our obligations.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations,
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling, affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors acting on behalf of Sparkling or such affiliated companies, in each case operating at Authorized Locations,

ops.oldText: Sparkling's right, if any, to use the Software and Documentation at locations other than the Authorized Locations
ops.newText: Notwithstanding Sections 3(c) and 20(d), Sparkling may assign this Agreement and the licence granted under this Section 2, without Garman's consent, to a successor in connection with a merger, amalgamation, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, provided such successor assumes Sparkling's obligations under this Agreement.
